/* cppi::078103926dbdc4d1d03171395363678959482629118145b69940eff3dc51cb11 */
SELECT business_date,
       portfolio_group_id,
       mp.pool_account_code,
       bcpp_unitized_percentage,
       acpp_unitized_percentage,
       scd_unitization,
       CASE
           WHEN bcpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * bcpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_bcpp_core_supp_mv,
       CASE
           WHEN acpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * acpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_acpp_core_supp_mv,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) AS herbi_total_market_value_pc,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_qc) AS herbi_total_market_value_qc
FROM (
         /* MAIN HOLDINGS */
         select mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                sum(market_value_pc) market_value_pc,
                sum(market_value_qc) market_value_qc,
                business_date from 
        (
         SELECT mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
                mh.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency AS market_value_qc,
                mh.business_date
         FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
         WHERE mh.business_date = '2025-06-06'
           AND mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'ACPP', 'BCPP')
       ) mh
         GROUP BY mh.model_portfolio_id,
                  mh.portfolio_group_id,
                  mh.business_date
     ) herbi
/* MODEL PORTFOLIO FREECODES */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT model_portfolio_id,
                           pool_account_code
                    FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
                    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-06') mp
                   ON herbi.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
/* UNITIZATION PERCENTAGE */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                           market_value_portfolio_currency_amount AS scd_unitization,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS acpp_unitized_percentage,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS bcpp_unitized_percentage
                    FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
                    WHERE acpp_bcpp_account_code IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP')
                      AND business_date = '2025-06-06'
                    GROUP BY unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                             market_value_portfolio_currency_amount) unitization
                   ON mp.pool_account_code = unitization.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
GROUP BY business_date,
         portfolio_group_id,
         mp.pool_account_code,
         bcpp_unitized_percentage,
         acpp_unitized_percentage,
         scd_unitization

/* cppi::053cde0462f3ea23074436c498d159c625c13e8bab64bc9bf0dfb1df55ef20e6 */
WITH
    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-05-10')
    )

SELECT
    'Listed RE'                                                 AS "Portfolio",
    holding.business_date                                       AS "Business Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                     AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    sec.isin                                                    AS "ISIN - Current",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))    AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                              AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    sec.sec_nm                                                  AS "Security Name - Current"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_re_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
 LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
        ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
       AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-05-10')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)

        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,

    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv

			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc

/* cppi::b386e61d8525ffb9c8a872db9c62c2e0f0bc9513fa5fdd75f298b44a4af1bd18 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-30')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-30')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-30')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT "scd_transaction_number_primary_key", "business_date", "abor_transaction_number", "abor_security_id", "abor_security_number", "abor_security_name", "model_portfolio_id", "portfolio_id", "business_transaction_code", "settlement_currency", "trade_date", "payment_date", "nominal", "nominal_basis", "elementary_transaction_code", "interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency", "interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency", "transaction_cancellation_flag", "reconciliation_status", "created_date", "transaction_number_in_originating_system", "payment_amount_quotation_currency", "payment_amount_portfolio_currency", "external_short_tag", "settlement_date", "settlement_location", "quotation_currency", "number_of_units", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_quotation_currency", "current_value_portfolio_currency", "current_value_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency", "ibor_reason", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "rn", "sst_custody_account_code", "model_portfolio_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "party_id", "epm_party_name", "abor_security_group_name", "abor_security_type_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "abor_coupon_rate", "country_ref_code", "esm_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_name", "portfolio_group_id", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "restitution_expected_settlement_currency", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
               ORDER BY extract_time DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1) AS "transactions_base"

        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1) AS "transactions_base"

  select
    h.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,

    NULL as id_enterprise_holding,
    h.abor_security_name as security_name,

    sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
    sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
    sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
    h.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,
    h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency * h.clean_price as clean_price_pc,
    h.clean_price as clean_price_qc,

    h.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc
  from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
  join (
  SELECT *,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			PARTITION BY abor_security_id
			ORDER BY business_date DESC
		) AS rn
	FROM reference.scd_securities
	WHERE business_date = '2025-06-06'
  ) sec
 on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
    where h.business_date = '2025-06-06'
    and (
     (h.security_group_id = 'PEDIRECT'   and h.abor_security_type_id = 'PEDIRECT')
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PESECOND'   and h.abor_security_type_id IN ('PRINCSEC', 'SECFUND'))
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PI DEBT'   and h.abor_security_type_id = 'IX-DPD OTH')
  OR (h.security_group_id = 'PFPREQUITY' and h.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUND OF FD','LARGEBO', 'LEGACY', 'MDMKTBOEU',

                            ELSE mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency
                        END as "balance_cost_local",

            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'

        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security

    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp

                ORDER BY business_date DESC

       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (

    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc

        st.abor_security_name,

        cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,

        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        st.created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        st.settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,

        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,

        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
-- ✅ Final deduplication after joins
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC, abor_transaction_number, trade_date, created_date
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        st.created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        st.settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,

    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp

        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id

    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss

    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country

        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (

        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id

        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)

        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
-- ✅ Final deduplication after joins
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC, abor_transaction_number, trade_date, created_date
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,

            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,

       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1

           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
-- ✅ Final deduplication after joins
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC, abor_transaction_number, trade_date, created_date
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

/* QuickSight 3864a534-ad1e-4f58-ad5d-0b416811ea2f */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'

WITH analytic_pv AS

     from radar_reporting_uat

    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-05'
    )

       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /

            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.acpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999

			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date

                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,

        SELECT

    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,

            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-06-05') and date '2025-06-05'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),

    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-06-05' and date '2025-06-05'

from max_arrival_time

/* QuickSight dd0f98d8-8644-463f-9f65-5c03882c4c7f */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class_DEV"

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
